item.title: Vanguard DAF Granted $3.9 Billion For 2025
item.description: (image from https://www.vanguardcharitable.org/) Users of the Vanguard Charitable donor-advised fund granted $3.9 billion to nearly 67,000 nonprofits during 2025. It’s the ninth straight year of record giving, the grantmaker announced. The grant total is an increase of 27% compared to 2024. item.title: Bitcoin, Ripple Led Crypto Donations In 2025
item.description: The average gift of cryptocurrency during 2025 was $11,019 across The Giving Block Platform, with 21% of the gifts were valued at $100,000. The average gift was more — $1,704 — if it came via a donor-advised fund.
